A Mage who is skilled at dealing AoE damage and imbuing buffs to allies.
很好，每一次进步都会记录在案。
Excellent. I'll track every step of progress.
My waves of knowledge will crush you!
得到了足以载入论文的成果。
When can we begin our research?
你曾经想过，为什么抛弃的东西会漂浮在空中吗？这是我第32篇论文的题目，论漂浮术的魔力构成。欢迎品鉴。
Have you ever wondered why some things can float in the air? My 32nd academic thesis, 'The Magical Composition Of Levitation', will tell you everything. You should read it.
便于行动的服装是田野调查的第一步。

動きやすい服を身につけることが、野外調査の第一歩ですよ。
Lightweight clothing is optimal for conducting fieldwork.

I can feel the current of magical energy... This is truly precious.
嗯……或许它能推动我的新研究？
Hmm... perhaps this will propel my new research?
沉静的流水终能汇入大海，而她是最纯粹的涓滴。
Like a single drop of starlight, she flows steadily toward her calling.
她走在路上，好奇心是头顶盛放的星光。
Fresh from the halls of magic, she walks boldly, her eyes bright with starlight and wonder.

科丝蒂已蝉联两届莱希拉姆魔法比赛冠军，每年赛后，她都会友善地邀请对手一同进餐，但都被对手果断拒绝。

Cassadee has won the Lyceum's magic tournament twice. Afterward, she would always invite her opponents to dinner in order to discuss spells and strategies and try to get feedback. She doesn't understand why they refused each time.
科丝蒂喜爱品茶，但口味独特，会在每杯茶水中加入5~7块方糖。
Cassadee likes to brew her tea with at least 5-7 cubes of sugar. When asked, she always replies that it helps her think, but everyone knows that she just has a sweet tooth.
甜品店“阿诺德悬岸的黎明”的最新糕点因为甜度太高，无人问津，只有科丝蒂是这家店的忠实食客。
The latest pastries at the Sunshore Bakery are too sweet for most customers, and they are losing business. However, Cassadee has been buying twice her weekly amount to keep the business going.
科丝蒂的借书卡上，超过80%的书名都提到了“梅林”或“魔法”，还有少部分书籍涉及心理学及人际关系管理。

Eight out of ten books Cassadee has borrowed from the library mention either Merlin or magic. The other two seem to cover psychology and interpersonal relationships. Her last book is "How to Win Friends and Influence Magic".
科丝蒂的学习笔记十分规整漂亮，每逢考试季，都有不少学生向她高价购入笔记抄写本。

Cassadee's study notes are very neat and orderly. Every exam season, other students often offer ridiculous amounts of money for copies of her notes. One very drowsy-looking student even offered her his yearly allowance for her herbology notes.
“她今天拿着一本画满符文的笔记问我法阵仪式的优化方法。天哪，第一名问我这种中等生真的好吗？”——法师希拉德

"She approached me today, asking about magic circle optimization. Are you serious? You're the top student in our class, and you're asking ME for help? I was honored and scared at the same time." —Pre-Magisterate Student Hillard
科丝蒂喜爱思想与逻辑碰撞交锋的知识较量，不过愿意陪她进行头脑风暴的友伴数量有限，每当这时，她就会转而投向书籍的海洋。

Cassadee loves discussions where ideas and thoughts clash. However, she doesn't have many friends. Even some teachers avoid her because they feel inadequate in their knowledge. In the end, she always turns to books, especially ones written by Merlin.
科丝蒂3岁时总喜欢把玩家中陶土制成的茶具，直至家人发现茶具中的水源源不绝，怎么倒都倒不空，才察觉她的水系魔法天赋。

When Cassadee was three, she loved to fiddle with the tea set her family had. When her parents realized that their teapot never ran out of tea, her innate gift of magic was discovered. However, the tea always tasted too sweet for her family.
科丝蒂梦想有一只“仓鼠使魔”——和传说的梅林一样。但她的召唤术往往只能唤出水元素。虽然迄今已经失败了113次，她仍未气馁。

Cassadee dreamed of having a hamster familiar, just like the legendary Merlin. However, she's only been able to summon water elementals so far. After 113 failed attempts, she still hasn't given up. The closest she got was a watery-looking gerbil.
当科丝蒂问出“为什么”时，说明一个新的研究课题即将诞生。

Whenever Cassadee asks the question, "Why?" A new research topic is born. Her questions have spawned theses that include "Structure and Function of Magical Society," "A Theory of Magical Justice," and "Magic, Capitalism, and Freedom."
我每天都会抽时间去湖边看看小蓝。
I visit the lakeshore every day to check on Little Lulu.
Water never stays the same for long.
梅林大人，我把我的魔法怀表改造了一下，现在它不仅可以接受简单的短讯，还可以在不使用魔力的情况下触发时间提醒！
Magister Merlin, I made some changes to my magic timepiece. It can receive short messages now, and I added an alarm that works even without magic!
梅林大人，经历了这次圣古堂事件，我才明白，宫廷魔法师这个职位所代表的责任与意义。
Magister Merlin, after everything that happened at the Hall of Ancients, I finally understand what it means to be a court mage.

说起来，科丝蒂小姐应该是正式经受过培训的魔法师吧？
咒语和研究方法看起来都很专业。

Miss Cassadee, you must be a properly trained mage.
Your spells and research methods look very professional.
